== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata)]] (<code>1281_35</code>, Virtual Block 8.1 slip 00), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-00-Scoundrels_Charm.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-scoundrelscharm-pre.gif]]) show the original text of [[Scoundrel's Charm]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. The lore is the printed slip's (“Sarcastic. Sardonic. Irreverent.”).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Once per turn, may peek at the top 3 cards of your Force pile and take one into hand; reshuffle. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from an opponent's just-drawn destiny.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1281_35</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 8 set mark, slip number 8, original-title strip, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
